hints: Look closely at the brackets. In −4², is the minus sign part of what gets squared?
Work out each part with the right sign, then add them.

solution.methodName: Write the power as repeated multiplication

steps.action: −4² has no brackets, so only the 4 is squared and the minus stays in front: −4² = −(4 × 4) = −16.
steps.why: A power acts only on the number right next to it. Without brackets, the minus sign is not squared.

steps.action: (−3)² has brackets, so the whole −3 is squared: (−3) × (−3) = 9.
steps.why: A negative times a negative is positive.

steps.action: Add: −16 + 9. The signs are different, so subtract the sizes: 16 − 9 = 7.
16 is the bigger size and it is negative, so the result is negative.

trapNotes.7: This flips both signs: 16 − 9 = 7. −4² is −16 and (−3)² is +9, so the sum is −16 + 9.
trapNotes.25: This reads −4² as +16: 16 + 9 = 25. Without brackets, only the 4 is squared, so −4² = −16.
trapNotes.−25: This reads (−3)² as −9: −16 − 9 = −25. With brackets the whole −3 is squared, and (−3) × (−3) = +9.
